charteredChapters.name: The American University in Cairo (AUC) Optica Student Chapter
charteredChapters.advisorDepartment: School of Sciences and Engineering / Physics and Nanotechnology
charteredChapters.description: The first and only formally chartered Optica Student Chapter in Egypt. Hosted within the School of Sciences and Engineering at AUC New Cairo, the chapter connects physics, optical engineering, and nanotechnology students with international researchers. The chapter is currently inactive while undergoing executive committee reactivation and student leadership onboarding.
highlights: First formally chartered Optica student chapter in Egypt, established in 2024.
Undergoing formal section-supported reactivation to reconstitute student leadership and activities.
Hosted international Optica Traveling Lecturer on advanced metamaterials and silicon photonics.

charterRoadmap.title: Assemble Core Student Members
charterRoadmap.body: Gather a minimum of five student members enrolled at your university who share an interest in optics, photonics, physics, or optical engineering.

charterRoadmap.title: Secure Faculty Advisor
charterRoadmap.body: Identify a faculty member or researcher affiliated with your department who is or agrees to become an active Optica professional member.

charterRoadmap.title: Adopt Chapter Constitution
charterRoadmap.body: Utilize the official Optica student chapter constitution template to define officer positions (President, Vice-President, Secretary, Treasurer).

charterRoadmap.title: Submit Charter Application
charterRoadmap.body: The Optica Egypt Local Section assists your team in submitting your charter package to the Optica Global Council for formal approval and initial funding.
